sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production Codec portrait expression sheet, original fan-made game artwork.
Primary request: Kazuhira Miller in Metal Gear Solid V Ground Zeroes, MSF era 1975, BEFORE Mother Base destruction. One consistent 29-year-old Japanese-American man in all six cells: angular face, medium blond hair brushed backward and tucked behind ears, long sideburns, dark aviator sunglasses, clean-shaven or very subtle stubble. Olive-green open collar military field jacket over plain dark crew-neck shirt. NO beret, NO trench coat, NO red tie, NO scarf, NO Diamond Dogs emblem, no scars or fresh blood, no amputations or walking stick. This must not be the 1984 Phantom Pain costume.
Composition: exactly THREE columns by TWO rows, six equal square panels, total landscape 1536x1024. No gutters or border lines. Each panel is a separate head-and-shoulders front-facing portrait, whole hairstyle visible with 7 percent headroom, shoulders cropped at bottom, identical camera and scale.
Reading order: top left neutral listening with closed mouth; top middle serious focused jaw and frown; top right warning urgent mid-speech open mouth; bottom left calm reassuring relaxed lips; bottom middle humor slight confident asymmetric smile; bottom right same identity with subtle horizontal analog transmission glitches, still recognizable.
Style: grounded realistic high-detail painted game portrait, restrained cinematic olive charcoal palette, soft emerald rim light, subtle skin detail, dark green-black plain background. Matches a mature military radio interface, not monochrome pixel art.
Constraints: anatomical consistency, glasses maintained in all expressions, no other people, no text, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no surrounding UI. Original composition based on the character's period-correct design, not a reproduction of official key art.
Reference grounding consulted: Konami Ground Zeroes introduction and timeline; Ground Zeroes 1975 Miller screenshots show blond swept-back hair, aviators and green open jacket with dark shirt. Preserve that era separation.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production Codec radio contact portrait expression sheet, original fan-made game artwork.
Primary request: Morpho, the MSF helicopter pilot from Metal Gear Solid V Ground Zeroes, 1975. Do not draw Pequod from Phantom Pain.
Reference grounding: the original cockpit screenshot Morpho.jpg was visually inspected: off-white/cream rigid rounded flight helmet, large circular earpiece with small dark fasteners and a linear detail, a broad dark visor band at eye level; lower face shadowed and visually unidentifiable; olive grey-green flight clothing with raised soft collar and creased shoulders. Hair entirely covered. Keep these features. No identifiable invented facial likeness.
Subject: one consistent anonymous male MSF helicopter pilot wearing this period off-white rounded helmet, dark opaque eyeshield, short thin boom radio microphone in front of mouth, lower face obscured naturally by deep helmet shadow and dark fabric. Olive flight suit with simple straps and raised collar. No futuristic helmet, no giant respirator, no oxygen hose, no baseball cap, no beret, no skull mask, no Diamond Dogs badges.
Composition: exact THREE columns by TWO rows, six equal square portrait cells, landscape 1536x1024. No gutters, frames or visible separators. Every cell centered head and shoulders, full helmet visible with 7 percent headroom, matching camera distance and shoulder crop.
Reading order: top left neutral attentive square posture; top middle serious slight chin down, focused head angle; top right warning leaning very slightly forward as he speaks into microphone; bottom left calm relaxed shoulders; bottom middle humor gently relaxed small 5-degree head tilt as if acknowledging a radio joke; bottom right neutral identity with moderate horizontal analog transmission distortion. Vary posture subtly while preserving one helmet, suit, scale and masked identity in all six cells. Expressions must never reveal a made-up face.
Style: grounded realistic high-detail painted game portraits, cinematic olive charcoal palette, soft restrained emerald rim light, matte cream helmet with gentle wear, plain green-black backdrop. Match the game's mature Codec portrait assets.
Constraints: one portrait per cell, no other people, no vehicles, no text, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no surrounding UI. An original adaptation grounded in the readable helmet/uniform design; do not invent a canonical unmasked face.
sources.limits: Helmet and flight-clothing reference inspected. No identifiable frontal face verified; shadowed face is a conservative fan-made adaptation, not an official likeness.
